combinations.name: Alcohol & CNS depressants
combinations.description: Sedation and slowed breathing add up, and ketamine's dissociation hides both. Vomiting is likelier too — dangerous if you can't protect your airway. Keep both doses low, and don't dose alone.

combinations.name: Stimulants
combinations.description: A stimulant hides ketamine's sedation, so a heavy dose can feel manageable — until the stimulant fades first and the full dose lands at once. Judge the ketamine as if the stimulant weren't there.
